sec14-card-sec14-F26.question_text: What must you do immediately when your engine stalls in floodwater across a road?
sec14-card-sec14-F26.teaching_text: Staying dry inside a dead car takes seconds to turn deadly when rising current sweeps the cabin downstream.

sec14-card-sec14-R02.question_text: At what speed does partial hydroplaning start, and when do tires ride completely on water?
sec14-card-sec14-R02.teaching_text: Memorizing those two exact twenty-mile-per-hour steps locks in one of West Virginia's favorite weather test numbers.

sec14-card-sec14-R03.question_text: Compare the water depth that floats small cars with the depth that carries most vehicles away?
sec14-card-sec14-R03.teaching_text: Drivers underestimate ankle-deep and knee-deep currents until tires lift off the pavement completely.
sec14-card-sec14-R03.must_match_memory_hook: Six inches floats, two feet carries

visual_sync.text_span: Six inches floats, two feet carries

sec14-card-sec14-F27.question_text: How much longer can stopping take on snow or ice, and which road structures freeze first?
sec14-card-sec14-F27.teaching_text: Cold air chills elevated decks from both above and below, catching fast drivers on surprise black ice.
sec14-card-sec14-F27.must_match_memory_hook: Twelve times longer, bridges ice first

visual_sync.text_span: Twelve times longer, bridges ice first

sec14-card-sec14-F28.question_text: What must be true of your windows, wipers, and defroster before you start driving in winter?
sec14-card-sec14-F28.teaching_text: Peeking through a scraped porthole hides pedestrians, lane mergers, and cross traffic on all sides.

sec14-card-sec14-F04.question_text: After a collision in heavy fog, why must you pull clear of the roadway immediately?
sec14-card-sec14-F04.teaching_text: Waiting in the lane for police turns one minor fender-bender into a chain-reaction multi-car wreck.

sec14-card-sec14-F05.question_text: How must you turn around on an interstate, and who is allowed to use median crossovers?

sec14-card-sec14-F08.question_text: What is defensive driving built on, and when should those habits start and apply?

sec14-card-sec14-F09.question_text: Which five personal traits produce bad driving habits that a safe driver must recognize and fix?
sec14-card-sec14-F09.teaching_text: Spotting those five attitude traps in yourself lets you correct risky shortcuts before they cause a wreck.

sec14-card-sec14-F10.question_text: What mirror, head-check, and turn-signal shortcuts mark a lazy driver?
sec14-card-sec14-F10.teaching_text: Relying on mirrors alone hides cars and cyclists in blind spots when changing lanes, leaving curbs, or opening doors.

sec14-card-sec14-F11.question_text: What stop rule applies even on right turns, and what three traffic habits show an impatient driver?
sec14-card-sec14-F11.teaching_text: Rolling red-light right turns and rushing bumper-to-bumper saves seconds while multiplying rear-end and crosswalk crashes.

sec14-card-sec14-F12.question_text: How does an attentive driver sit and hold the wheel compared with an inattentive driver?
sec14-card-sec14-F12.teaching_text: Slouching with one arm hanging out the window lets the car drift before you even notice traffic slowing.

sec14-card-sec14-F13.question_text: How does an arrogant or aggressive driver differ from someone who is merely impatient, and how should you react?
sec14-card-sec14-F13.teaching_text: Matching an aggressive driver's ego turns one reckless vehicle into a two-car road-rage hazard.

sec14-card-sec14-F14.question_text: Why must you avoid daydreaming, window shopping, scenic staring, or distracting talk at the wheel?

sec14-card-sec14-R09.question_text: Do empty cross streets or cars behind you ever excuse skipping a complete stop when turning right?

sec14-card-sec14-R10.question_text: What separates an impatient driver from an arrogant or aggressive driver?

sec14-card-sec14-F33.question_text: Which construction and surface features make up the road conditions a defensive driver watches for?

sec16-card-sec16-F32.teaching_text: Verifying the official truck, badge, reflective vest, and passenger-side walk-up confirms help is authentic before unlocking.

sec16-card-sec16-F33.question_text: What fine range, jail term, cleanup hours, and license consequence can result from a littering conviction?
sec16-card-sec16-F33.teaching_text: Tossing trash from a car window can add driver-record points alongside steep fines or thirty hours of roadside pickup.
sec16-card-sec16-F33.must_match_memory_hook: Up to thousand, jail, cleanup, points

visual_sync.text_span: Up to thousand, jail, cleanup, points

sec16-card-sec16-F34.question_text: Which four vehicle wastes threaten the environment most, and how much water can a single oil change ruin?
sec16-card-sec16-F34.teaching_text: Dumping oil, tires, antifreeze, or lead-acid batteries poisons groundwater, breeds mosquitoes, and spreads toxic metals.

sec16-card-sec16-F35.question_text: Where can you properly recycle used motor oil, old tires, antifreeze, and vehicle batteries?
sec16-card-sec16-F35.teaching_text: Auto parts stores take oil free and battery sellers must accept old cores by law, leaving zero excuse for dumping.
sec16-card-sec16-F35.must_match_memory_hook: Retailers and shops recycle all four

visual_sync.text_span: Retailers and shops recycle all four

sec16-card-sec16-R09.question_text: Recap the fine range, jail cap, minimum cleanup hours, and license impact of West Virginia littering?
sec16-card-sec16-R09.teaching_text: Remembering all three penalty numbers plus possible license points locks down every litter-law exam question.
sec16-card-sec16-R09.must_match_memory_hook: Fifty to thousand, sixty days, thirty

visual_sync.text_span: Fifty to thousand, sixty days, thirty

sec16-card-sec16-R12.question_text: What visual truck clues and driver habit confirm a Courtesy Patrol stop is legitimate?
sec16-card-sec16-R12.teaching_text: Approaching on the away-from-traffic passenger side protects both the operator from passing rigs and your peace of mind.
sec16-card-sec16-R12.must_match_memory_hook: Blue-gold white truck, badge, passenger side

visual_sync.text_span: Blue-gold white truck, badge, passenger side

sec04-card-sec04-F19.question_text: What convictions and details does the point system record, and what can repeated moving violations trigger?
sec04-card-sec04-F19.teaching_text: Both in-state and out-of-state moving tickets stack onto your file by severity until suspension kicks in.

sec04-card-sec04-F20.question_text: How long do assessed points remain active on your West Virginia driving record?
sec04-card-sec04-F20.teaching_text: Watch the starting event on test questions because the two-year clock runs from conviction date rather than citation date.

sec04-card-sec04-F21.question_text: What action happens when your record reaches six points versus twelve points?
sec04-card-sec04-F21.teaching_text: Treat that six-point caution letter as your halfway warning before twelve points sidelines your license.

sec04-card-sec04-F22.question_text: How many points can an approved eight-hour defensive driving class remove, how often, and what timing trap blocks credit?
sec04-card-sec04-F22.teaching_text: Taking an unapproved course or finishing class before points actually hit your record forfeits the three-point deduction.
sec04-card-sec04-F22.must_match_memory_hook: Minus three yearly after points post

visual_sync.text_span: Minus three yearly after points post

sec04-card-sec04-F34.question_text: How many points does fleeing from a law-enforcement officer add to your record?
sec04-card-sec04-F34.teaching_text: Eight points is the single steepest hit on West Virginia's scale, putting you two-thirds toward suspension instantly.

sec04-card-sec04-F35.question_text: Which four serious violations each carry six points on the West Virginia scale?
sec04-card-sec04-F35.teaching_text: Any single six-point conviction triggers an immediate caution letter and puts you one repeat away from twelve.

sec04-card-sec04-F36.question_text: How many points attach to speeding fifteen to nineteen miles per hour over versus eleven to fourteen over?
sec04-card-sec04-F36.teaching_text: Even moderate highway speeding adds three or five points that linger for two full years.

sec04-card-sec04-F37.question_text: How many points apply to repeat wireless offenses, bad passes, yield or signal failures, left-of-center driving, and lost control?
sec04-card-sec04-F37.teaching_text: Running red lights, blowing stop signs, driving too fast for rain, or third phone tickets each add three points.

sec04-card-sec04-F38.question_text: How many points apply to careless driving, wrong-way streets, littering, lane or safety-zone violations, and disobeying police?
sec04-card-sec04-F38.teaching_text: Tossing trash out a window surprises drivers by adding three license points just like wrong-way driving.

sec04-card-sec04-F39.question_text: Which everyday errors and unlisted moving violations carry two points on the scale?
sec04-card-sec04-F39.teaching_text: Packing four people onto a front bench, skipping turn signals, tailgating, or unlisted moving tickets all cost two points.

sec04-card-sec04-R01.question_text: How does the state's response at six points differ from reaching twelve points?
sec04-card-sec04-R01.teaching_text: Keep six and twelve distinct because exam distractors claim suspension starts at six.

sec04-card-sec04-R02.question_text: How often may you use the three-point defensive driving deduction compared with how long points stay on file?
sec04-card-sec04-R02.teaching_text: You can shave three points once every twelve months while underlying convictions take twenty-four months to age off.
sec04-card-sec04-R02.must_match_memory_hook: Class yearly, points last two years

visual_sync.text_span: Class yearly, points last two years

sec04-card-sec04-R07.question_text: How do the three speeding brackets step up from eleven miles per hour over past twenty over?
sec04-card-sec04-R07.teaching_text: Lock in the three-five-six ladder across eleven-to-fourteen, fifteen-to-nineteen, and twenty-plus over the posted limit.

sec04-card-sec04-R13.question_text: Which violation sits alone at the eight-point top of the scale, and which sit at the two-point bottom?
sec04-card-sec04-R13.teaching_text: Anchoring eight points to fleeing police and two points to tailgating frames every tier in between.

sec04-card-sec04-F07.question_text: What happens if your vehicle lacked required West Virginia liability coverage on the date of a crash?
sec04-card-sec04-F07.teaching_text: Even if the other motorist caused the wreck, driving uninsured suspends both your tags and your license.

sec04-card-sec04-F08.question_text: What insurance coverage must every motorist carry when driving on West Virginia public roads?
sec04-card-sec04-F08.teaching_text: Liability insurance protects everyone else you might injure or damage on public highways.

sec04-card-sec04-F09.question_text: How long must liability coverage stay active on a registered car, and what must you do if insurance cancels?
sec04-card-sec04-F09.teaching_text: Dropping insurance on a parked project car without turning in the license plate triggers automatic suspension penalties.

sec04-card-sec04-F10.question_text: Does a digital insurance image on your phone count, and when must you show proof alongside registration?
sec04-card-sec04-F10.teaching_text: Keeping a current insurance screen saved offline ensures you can show proof at crashes, stops, and state inspections.

sec04-card-sec04-F11.question_text: How can West Virginia verify your insurance mid-year, and what happens if you fail to prove coverage?
sec04-card-sec04-F11.teaching_text: Direct electronic verification catches lapsed policies randomly without waiting for a traffic stop.

sec04-card-sec04-F12.question_text: What follows a ticket or crash report showing no insurance, and how do you reinstate?
sec04-card-sec04-F12.teaching_text: Each repeat uninsured offense stretches license loss longer and demands active coverage plus mandatory reinstatement fees.

sec04-card-sec04-F13.question_text: What administrative and criminal penalties punish filing false or fraudulent insurance information?
sec04-card-sec04-F13.teaching_text: Forging an insurance card adds ninety days of license loss, revokes tags, and risks a year behind bars.
sec04-card-sec04-F13.must_match_memory_hook: Ninety-day suspension, thousand fine, year jail

visual_sync.text_span: Ninety-day suspension, thousand fine, year jail

sec04-card-sec04-R05.question_text: Which three loss categories make up West Virginia's mandatory minimum liability insurance structure?
sec04-card-sec04-R05.teaching_text: Split-limit policies always pair per-person injury, per-crash multi-person injury, and third-party property damage.

sec04-card-sec04-F14.question_text: When may an adult use an electronic communications device while driving, and how much does wireless use cut concentration?
sec04-card-sec04-F14.teaching_text: Even quick wireless calls slice mental focus by twenty to thirty-three percent when traffic shifts suddenly.
sec04-card-sec04-F14.must_match_memory_hook: Hands-free only, focus drops a third

visual_sync.text_span: Hands-free only, focus drops a third

sec04-card-sec04-F15.question_text: What makes equipment hands-free, and which gadgets beyond cell phones fall under the electronic-device law?
sec04-card-sec04-F15.teaching_text: Laptops, tablets, handheld games, pagers, and messaging units are all banned unless operated without hands.

sec04-card-sec04-F16.question_text: Which calling, viewing, gaming, or messaging actions on a non-hands-free device break West Virginia law?
sec04-card-sec04-F16.teaching_text: Reading a text at a glance or scrolling email breaks the law just as much as typing.
sec04-card-sec04-F16.must_match_memory_hook: Any handheld call text browse game

visual_sync.text_span: Any handheld call text browse game

sec04-card-sec04-F17.question_text: What fines and license points apply to first, second, and third-or-later handheld-device offenses?
sec04-card-sec04-F17.teaching_text: Zero points on your first two tickets lulls drivers before ticket number three drops three hundred dollars plus three points.
sec04-card-sec04-F17.must_match_memory_hook: One hundred, two hundred, three-hundred three-points

visual_sync.text_span: One hundred, two hundred, three-hundred three-points

sec04-card-sec04-F18.question_text: Which emergency reports and official responders are exempt from the electronic-device ban?
sec04-card-sec04-F18.teaching_text: Calling authorities about a fire, wreck, or dangerous road hazard is always lawful, alongside on-duty emergency crews.

sec04-card-sec04-R03.question_text: On which offense number do driving-record points first attach to electronic-device violations?
sec04-card-sec04-R03.teaching_text: Test questions check whether you mistakenly add points on the first handheld citation instead of the third.

sec04-card-sec04-R09.question_text: What single distinction separates lawful adult electronic-device use from a violation while driving?
sec04-card-sec04-R09.teaching_text: Adults may use hands-free devices while driving, whereas drivers under eighteen are barred completely except for emergencies.

sec04-card-sec04-F28.question_text: Which homicide, graduated-driver, false-statement, or hit-and-run convictions force mandatory license revocation?
sec04-card-sec04-F28.teaching_text: Leaving an injury or fatal crash, lying on licensing forms, or two teen moving convictions forces automatic revocation.
sec04-card-sec04-F28.must_match_memory_hook: Vehicular homicide, teen repeats, injury hit-and-run

visual_sync.text_span: Vehicular homicide, teen repeats, injury hit-and-run

sec04-card-sec04-F29.question_text: Which reckless-driving streak, street-racing, suspended-driving, or civil-judgment failures force mandatory revocation?
sec04-card-sec04-F29.teaching_text: Three reckless convictions inside twenty-four months or ignoring a court crash-damage judgment terminates your license.
sec04-card-sec04-F29.must_match_memory_hook: Three reckless, racing, suspended, unpaid judgment

visual_sync.text_span: Three reckless, racing, suspended, unpaid judgment

sec04-card-sec04-F30.question_text: Which impaired-driving, fuel-theft, or felony convictions trigger mandatory license revocation?
sec04-card-sec04-F30.teaching_text: Notice a second conviction for driving off without paying for gasoline revokes your license alongside any vehicle felony.
sec04-card-sec04-F30.must_match_memory_hook: Any-state impaired, second gas-skip, vehicle felony

visual_sync.text_span: Any-state impaired, second gas-skip, vehicle felony

sec04-card-sec04-F31.question_text: How do penalties compare between driving while suspended for non-alcohol reasons versus driving while revoked for impaired driving?
sec04-card-sec04-F31.teaching_text: Getting caught behind the wheel while revoked for impaired driving brings mandatory jail from thirty days to six months.

sec04-card-sec04-F27.question_text: What suspension penalty hits someone who lies on an application, lends or borrows a license, shares identity papers, or shows a fake card?
sec04-card-sec04-F27.teaching_text: Letting a friend borrow your card or birth certificate suspends your own real driving privilege for ninety days.

sec04-card-sec04-R06.question_text: What separates the penalty for driving on a general suspension from driving while revoked for impaired driving?
sec04-card-sec04-R06.teaching_text: Judges cannot waive that thirty-day minimum jail floor when a motorist drives on an impaired-driving revocation.
sec04-card-sec04-R06.must_match_memory_hook: Mandatory thirty-day-to-six-month jail plus six-month revoke

visual_sync.text_span: Mandatory thirty-day-to-six-month jail plus six-month revoke

sec04-card-sec04-R10.question_text: How many reckless-driving convictions in twenty-four months or moving violations as a graduated driver trigger mandatory revocation?
sec04-card-sec04-R10.teaching_text: Three reckless convictions inside two years or just two moving tickets as a graduated teen both trigger revocation.
sec04-card-sec04-R10.must_match_memory_hook: Three reckless in twenty-four, two graduated

visual_sync.text_span: Three reckless in twenty-four, two graduated

sec04-card-sec04-F06.question_text: Which crashes must be reported, within how many days, and to which police agency inside versus outside city limits?
sec04-card-sec04-F06.teaching_text: Report inside city limits to local police, or outside city limits to the county sheriff or State Police.
sec04-card-sec04-F06.must_match_memory_hook: Injury death thousand-damage within five days

visual_sync.text_span: Injury death thousand-damage within five days

sec04-card-sec04-F23.question_text: How does the Driver License Compact treat moving violations and revocations from other states?
sec04-card-sec04-F23.teaching_text: Road-trip speeding or impaired convictions follow you home onto your West Virginia point and suspension file.

sec04-card-sec04-F24.question_text: What two-way deal does the Non-Resident Violator Compact create when you receive a ticket in another member state?
sec04-card-sec04-F24.teaching_text: Officers let out-of-state travelers sign and continue their trip because your home state suspends you if ignored.
sec04-card-sec04-F24.must_match_memory_hook: Drive onward now, ignore suspends home

visual_sync.text_span: Drive onward now, ignore suspends home

sec04-card-sec04-F25.question_text: What happens to your driver's license if you fail to appear or comply with any municipal, magistrate, or circuit court order?
sec04-card-sec04-F25.teaching_text: Skipping a non-traffic court summons still triggers state license suspension until compliance proof and fees are paid.

sec04-card-sec04-F26.question_text: What family-court financial failure requires West Virginia to suspend a driver's license?
sec04-card-sec04-F26.teaching_text: State law links highway driving privileges directly to staying current on court-ordered child support.

sec04-card-sec04-F32.question_text: Through which three channels are West Virginia suspension, revocation, and reinstatement transactions handled?
sec04-card-sec04-F32.teaching_text: Reinstatements route through Charleston headquarters, its dedicated post office box, or the self-service web portal.

sec04-card-sec04-F33.question_text: What can you check for free on the online services portal, and what does buying your driving record cost?
sec04-card-sec04-F33.teaching_text: You can check license status, point totals, and commercial medical dates online, buy records for twelve-fifty, or pay reinstatements.

sec04-card-sec04-R04.question_text: What dollar threshold of property damage triggers mandatory five-day crash reporting when nobody is hurt?
sec04-card-sec04-R04.teaching_text: Modern bumper sensors easily pass one thousand dollars in minor parking-lot or fender impacts.
sec04-card-sec04-R04.must_match_memory_hook: Over one thousand within five days

visual_sync.text_span: Over one thousand within five days

sec04-card-sec04-R08.question_text: How do the Driver License Compact and the Non-Resident Violator Compact split out-of-state enforcement?
sec04-card-sec04-R08.teaching_text: Think convictions-and-points for the License Compact versus sign-and-comply ticket follow-through for the Violator Compact.
sec04-card-sec04-R08.must_match_memory_hook: License posts convictions, Violator enforces unpaid

visual_sync.text_span: License posts convictions, Violator enforces unpaid

sec04-card-sec04-R11.question_text: Which two obligations outside moving traffic stops still force West Virginia to suspend your license?
sec04-card-sec04-R11.teaching_text: Clean driving alone cannot save your license if you ignore court orders or fall behind on child support.
sec04-card-sec04-R11.must_match_memory_hook: Any court default or child support

visual_sync.text_span: Any court default or child support

sec04-card-sec04-F01.question_text: Who bears responsibility for your actions behind the wheel and knowing how to keep your West Virginia driving privilege?
sec04-card-sec04-F01.teaching_text: Blaming passengers, navigation directions, or ignorance of state rules never excuses a licensed motorist.

sec04-card-sec04-F02.question_text: How does West Virginia restrict a minor's license after excessive unexcused school absences, and how are full privileges restored?
sec04-card-sec04-F02.teaching_text: Skipping class shrinks teen driving to essential trips until turning eighteen or submitting school authorization plus reinstatement fees.
sec04-card-sec04-F02.must_match_memory_hook: Work medical school church until cleared

visual_sync.text_span: Work medical school church until cleared

sec04-card-sec04-F03.question_text: How can someone refer an immediate family member who can no longer drive safely, and who else may report?
sec04-card-sec04-F03.teaching_text: Detailed letters to the Medical Section, or reports from doctors and police, trigger safety reviews before crashes happen.

sec04-card-sec04-F04.question_text: What evaluations and licensing actions can follow an unsafe-driver referral?
sec04-card-sec04-F04.teaching_text: Adding daylight or mirror restrictions often keeps referred drivers independent when safe, while severe risks bring revocation.
sec04-card-sec04-F04.must_match_memory_hook: Reexamine skills or doctor, restrict revoke

visual_sync.text_span: Reexamine skills or doctor, restrict revoke

sec04-card-sec04-F05.question_text: When can the Commissioner order medical, written, or road retesting, and what happens if you refuse?
sec04-card-sec04-F05.teaching_text: Ignoring a re-examination notice automatically gives grounds to suspend or revoke your license without waiting.

sec04-card-sec04-R12.question_text: How do family unsafe-driver referrals and refusing a required re-examination connect?
sec04-card-sec04-R12.teaching_text: Once a referral triggers an official re-examination order, skipping that test loses the license on its own.

sec05-card-sec05-F08.question_text: What is West Virginia's legal drinking age, and what happens if a younger driver has measurable alcohol?
sec05-card-sec05-F08.teaching_text: Even a single sip registers on a breath check and strips a teen or twenty-year-old driver of road privileges.

sec05-card-sec05-F10.question_text: How does West Virginia law treat concentrations above point zero five versus point zero eight or higher?
sec05-card-sec05-F10.teaching_text: Waiting for point zero eight will not protect your card because impairment above point zero five can still trigger revocation.

sec05-card-sec05-F11.question_text: What does the handbook's eleven-thirty-to-four-morning example prove about drinking faster than one drink hourly?
sec05-card-sec05-F11.teaching_text: Stopping drinks before midnight still leaves bloodstream concentration climbing and above point zero six at four in the morning.

sec05-card-sec05-F17.question_text: What fine, jail rule, and minimum license revocation apply to a first zero-tolerance violation?
sec05-card-sec05-F17.teaching_text: Although a first underage alcohol stop carries zero jail time, losing your license for at least a month disrupts school and work.

sec05-card-sec05-F18.question_text: What fine, jail time, and revocation length hit a driver on a second zero-tolerance offense?
sec05-card-sec05-F18.teaching_text: A repeat underage violation adds mandatory twenty-four-hour lockup, up to five hundred dollars, and revocation past sixty days or age eighteen.

sec05-card-sec05-R01.question_text: How do the legal meanings of above point zero five, point zero eight, and underage measurable alcohol compare?
sec05-card-sec05-R01.teaching_text: Written questions mix all three benchmarks to verify you separate adult evidence, adult presumption, and strict under-twenty-one bans.

sec05-card-sec05-R02.question_text: How do jail time and minimum revocation escalate from a first zero-tolerance offense to a second?
sec05-card-sec05-R02.teaching_text: Moving from a first offense to a second adds twenty-four hours behind bars and doubles or extends license loss until eighteen.

sec05-card-sec05-F19.question_text: What penalties apply to a first DUI below point one five or knowingly letting an impaired person drive?
sec05-card-sec05-F19.teaching_text: Handing your keys to an impaired friend brings the exact same hundred-to-five-hundred fine, jail exposure, and revocation as driving yourself.

sec05-card-sec05-F20.question_text: What fine, jail range, and minimum revocation apply when a first DUI reaches point one five or higher?
sec05-card-sec05-F20.teaching_text: Hitting point one five triples minimum revocation from fifteen days to forty-five, mandates jail, and doubles top fines to a thousand.

sec05-card-sec05-F21.question_text: What penalties apply when a driver commits DUI with child endangerment?
sec05-card-sec05-F21.teaching_text: Putting a minor inside an impaired driver's vehicle triggers up to a year in jail, thousand-dollar fines, and sixty-day revocation.

sec05-card-sec05-F22.question_text: What fine, jail range, and minimum revocation follow a DUI involving bodily injury?
sec05-card-sec05-F22.teaching_text: Hurting someone in an impaired crash carries mandatory lockup up to twelve months, thousand-dollar fines, and at least sixty days revoked.

sec05-card-sec05-F23.question_text: How severe are the fine, prison range, and revocation for a DUI causing serious bodily injury?
sec05-card-sec05-F23.teaching_text: Causing severe trauma behind the wheel escalates fines up to three thousand dollars, multi-year incarceration, and sixty-plus days revoked.

sec05-card-sec05-F24.question_text: How is a DUI resulting in death classified, and what prison term and license penalty follow?
sec05-card-sec05-F24.teaching_text: Taking a life while impaired permanently ends your driving privilege and carries up to three decades in prison.

sec05-card-sec05-F25.question_text: What fine, jail sentence, and minimum revocation apply to a second DUI offense?
sec05-card-sec05-F25.teaching_text: A second impaired conviction locks in at least half a year behind bars, up to three thousand dollars, and one year off roads.

sec05-card-sec05-F26.question_text: What fine, incarceration term, and minimum revocation hit a third or subsequent DUI offender?
sec05-card-sec05-F26.teaching_text: Repeat third offenses push fines to three-to-five thousand dollars and multi-year prison alongside at least a one-year revocation.

sec05-card-sec05-F15.question_text: How long does license revocation last when a driver under eighteen commits a DUI?
sec05-card-sec05-F15.teaching_text: Turning eighteen alone never restores your card early if the offense's statutory revocation window or reinstatement requirements run longer.

sec05-card-sec05-F16.question_text: What program must every driver revoked or suspended for DUI finish before getting a license back?
sec05-card-sec05-F16.teaching_text: Waiting out the calendar revocation period never restores driving privileges until the prescribed state education and treatment course is done.

sec05-card-sec05-R03.question_text: How does minimum license revocation change between a first DUI below point one five and one at or above it?
sec05-card-sec05-R03.teaching_text: Crossing the point one five high-alcohol mark triples minimum revocation time on a first offense right out of the gate.

sec05-card-sec05-R04.question_text: What stays the same and what increases between second and third DUI offenses?
sec05-card-sec05-R04.teaching_text: Both carry a one-year minimum revocation, yet third offenses jump from months to years incarcerated and up to five thousand dollars.

sec05-card-sec05-R05.question_text: Which penalty detail separates DUI with child endangerment from DUI with bodily injury?
sec05-card-sec05-R05.teaching_text: Both share two-hundred-to-thousand-dollar fines and sixty-day revocations, yet endangering a child doubles the mandatory minimum jail floor.

sec05-card-sec05-R11.question_text: What two hurdles stand between an under-eighteen DUI offender and license reinstatement?
sec05-card-sec05-R11.teaching_text: Juvenile offenders serve whichever lasts longer between turning eighteen and statutory time, then still must finish Safety and Treatment.

sec05-card-sec05-F13.question_text: Which chemical check have arrested DUI suspects already consented to, and what penalty hits refusal?
sec05-card-sec05-F13.teaching_text: Saying no to the post-arrest breath machine triggers an administrative revocation lasting one full year up to a lifetime.

sec05-card-sec05-F14.question_text: How does West Virginia's implied consent law protect both sober motorists and the general public?
sec05-card-sec05-F14.teaching_text: Medically accepted breath readings exonerate sober drivers whose symptoms mimic alcohol while keeping uncooperative suspects off highways.

sec05-card-sec05-F27.question_text: What driving restriction and mechanical safeguard define West Virginia's Interlock Program after an alcohol DUI?
sec05-card-sec05-F27.teaching_text: Participants may drive legally only inside vehicles wired with a breath-screening starter lock that refuses alcohol.

sec05-card-sec05-F28.question_text: When does joining the Interlock Program stop being optional and become mandatory?
sec05-card-sec05-F28.teaching_text: Any second or subsequent DUI-related revocation inside a ten-year window locks in mandatory ignition interlock participation.

sec05-card-sec05-F29.question_text: How does getting Interlock approval before your scheduled revocation start date change your downtime?
sec05-card-sec05-F29.teaching_text: Filing late can force you to sit out the full hard revocation without driving and still complete interlock afterward.

sec05-card-sec05-R06.question_text: How does implied-consent breath refusal relate to underlying DUI court penalties?
sec05-card-sec05-R06.teaching_text: Refusing the breath check strips your license for a year up to life on its own, independent of DUI sentencing.

sec05-card-sec05-R07.question_text: What repeat-offense count mandates Interlock, and what filing timing avoids sitting out minimum revocation?
sec05-card-sec05-R07.teaching_text: Two revocations in ten years make interlock compulsory, while pre-revocation approval lets approved drivers install without downtime.

sec05-card-sec05-F01.question_text: Roughly what percentage of recent West Virginia fatal crashes involved alcohol-impaired drivers?
sec05-card-sec05-F01.teaching_text: Nearly three out of every ten deadly wrecks statewide trace back to drivers mixing alcohol with the wheel.

sec05-card-sec05-F02.question_text: Are drivers twenty-one and older the only group involved in alcohol-related fatal crashes?
sec05-card-sec05-F02.teaching_text: Inexperience combined with illegal underage drinking puts young drivers directly inside fatal DUI statistics.

sec05-card-sec05-F03.question_text: Which three core driving abilities does alcohol degrade right away?
sec05-card-sec05-F03.teaching_text: Losing sharp eyesight, hazard awareness, and sound decision-making simultaneously cripples safe vehicle control.

sec05-card-sec05-F04.question_text: Why can the exact same drink hit the same person harder on one day than another?
sec05-card-sec05-F04.teaching_text: Fatigue, stress, medications, or an empty stomach accelerate impairment even when drink count stays small.

sec05-card-sec05-F05.question_text: What actually lowers alcohol impairment when someone tries coffee, cold showers, exercise, or fresh air?
sec05-card-sec05-F05.teaching_text: Caffeine and cold water create a wide-awake impaired driver while the liver processes alcohol at a fixed pace.

sec05-card-sec05-F06.question_text: How does the pure alcohol content compare across a one-ounce hundred-proof shot, six-ounce wine, and twelve-ounce beer?
sec05-card-sec05-F06.teaching_text: Switching from liquor to beer never lowers intoxication when each standard serving delivers equal pure alcohol.

sec05-card-sec05-F07.question_text: Why can a person who has been drinking not trust their own decision that they are fine to drive?
sec05-card-sec05-F07.teaching_text: Alcohol impairs the brain's self-check circuits first, making intoxicated people feel confident while driving poorly.

sec05-card-sec05-F09.question_text: What defines a true designated driver, and when should the group choose that person?
sec05-card-sec05-F09.teaching_text: Picking the least-intoxicated friend at midnight fails because a true designated driver drinks zero alcohol from the start.

sec05-card-sec05-F12.question_text: How can prescription or over-the-counter drugs affect driving, especially when mixed with alcohol?
sec05-card-sec05-F12.teaching_text: Legal allergy pills or prescriptions can trigger severe drowsiness, hallucinations, or fatal synergy alongside alcohol.

sec05-card-sec05-R08.question_text: How much do black coffee, exercise, fresh air, and cold showers change bloodstream alcohol concentration?
sec05-card-sec05-R08.teaching_text: No folk trick speeds liver metabolism, leaving time as the sole factor lowering bloodstream concentration.

sec05-card-sec05-R09.question_text: Why do a twelve-ounce beer, six-ounce wine, and one-ounce whiskey shot hit with equal alcohol?
sec05-card-sec05-R09.teaching_text: Higher alcohol concentration in smaller pours balances larger liquid volume in beer or wine.

sec05-card-sec05-F30.question_text: After roughly how many hours awake do driving skills drop to alcohol- or drug-impaired performance?
sec05-card-sec05-F30.teaching_text: Pulling an eighteen-hour day slows reaction speed and spikes crash odds just like chemical intoxication.

sec05-card-sec05-F31.question_text: In what five ways does drowsiness degrade a driver's performance at the wheel?
sec05-card-sec05-F31.teaching_text: Tired brains miss multi-lane cues and make sloppy choices moments before micro-sleeps take the wheel completely.

sec05-card-sec05-F32.question_text: What should you do when drowsiness hits on the road, and how short a nap helps?
sec05-card-sec05-F32.teaching_text: Pushing through heavy eyelids invites a highway runoff when even a safe ten-to-twenty-minute rest restores focus.

sec05-card-sec05-F33.question_text: During which three daily windows do drivers commonly feel sleepy, and what ride alternatives help?
sec05-card-sec05-F33.teaching_text: Handing keys to a rested friend, carpooling, or taking transit beats fighting natural body-clock dips solo.

sec05-card-sec05-F34.question_text: Which vehicle movements and driver posture clues warn that another motorist nearby is drowsy?
sec05-card-sec05-F34.teaching_text: Giving wide space to erratic speed swings, rumble-strip hits, or nodding heads keeps you clear of sudden rear-ends.

sec05-card-sec05-F35.question_text: Which physical and memory warning signs prove you yourself are too drowsy to keep driving?
sec05-card-sec05-F35.teaching_text: Forgetting the last few miles, yawning, rubbing watery eyes, or hitting rumble strips means pull over immediately.

sec05-card-sec05-R10.question_text: How do the eighteen-hour wakefulness danger point and the effective roadside nap length compare?
sec05-card-sec05-R10.teaching_text: Staying up eighteen hours wrecks reflexes like alcohol, whereas stopping safely for ten to twenty minutes restores alertness.

sec08-card-sec08-F04.question_text: Which movements does a circular green signal permit, and to whom must a left-turning driver yield?
sec08-card-sec08-F04.teaching_text: Without a green arrow, circular green leaves oncoming traffic moving straight at full speed with priority.

sec08-card-sec08-F05.question_text: What movement does a lighted green arrow authorize, and what is usually true on a left-turn green arrow?
sec08-card-sec08-F05.teaching_text: Protected left-turn arrows hold opposing lanes on red, though scanning for red-light runners stays smart.

sec08-card-sec08-F06.question_text: What do steady circular yellow and yellow arrows warn, and when is driving through yellow appropriate?
sec08-card-sec08-F06.teaching_text: Only vehicles already inside intersection clearance should continue through as green transitions to red.

sec08-card-sec08-F07.question_text: What must drivers facing a steady circular red do, and what two exceptions allow movement?
sec08-card-sec08-F07.teaching_text: Aside from a simultaneous green arrow or a lawful after-stop turn on red, circular red requires holding stopped.

sec08-card-sec08-F08.question_text: Under what street layouts and conditions may West Virginia drivers turn right or left on red?
sec08-card-sec08-F08.teaching_text: Right on red works at two-way corners while left on red requires one-way-to-one-way streets, yielding, and zero bans.

sec08-card-sec08-F09.question_text: Where must you stop for a steady red arrow, and how long must you hold?
sec08-card-sec08-F09.teaching_text: Rolling into a red-arrow turn earns a ticket because you must wait until the red arrow extinguishes.

sec08-card-sec08-R01.question_text: How does turning permission differ between a steady circular red and a steady red arrow?
sec08-card-sec08-R01.teaching_text: Drivers confuse the two and get cited turning right against a lighted red right arrow.

sec08-card-sec08-R02.question_text: How does oncoming traffic behave during a circular-green left turn versus a green-arrow left turn?
sec08-card-sec08-R02.teaching_text: Assuming opposing traffic stopped when you only have a round green ball causes severe intersection T-bones.

sec08-card-sec08-R08.question_text: How do the street requirements compare for turning right on red versus turning left on red?
sec08-card-sec08-R08.teaching_text: Left on red works solely between two intersecting single-direction streets so you never cross oncoming lanes.

sec08-card-sec08-F18.question_text: What three jobs do pavement markings perform, and how do white and yellow lines differ?
sec08-card-sec08-F18.teaching_text: Checking stripe color tells you instantly whether neighboring lanes flow forward with you or head-on toward you.

sec08-card-sec08-F19.question_text: What traffic does a broken yellow line divide, and when does it allow passing?
sec08-card-sec08-F19.teaching_text: Having yellow dashes on your side grants legal permission only when forward sightlines and oncoming lanes are clear.

sec08-card-sec08-F20.question_text: What does a solid yellow stripe on your side forbid, and where does solid yellow mark the left pavement edge?
sec08-card-sec08-F20.teaching_text: On interstates, one-ways, and divided four-lane highways, keeping solid yellow on your left prevents wrong-way median drops.

sec08-card-sec08-F21.question_text: How are multilane same-direction roads striped, why is black sometimes added, and what straddling rule applies?
sec08-card-sec08-F21.teaching_text: Black contrast dashes boost glare visibility on light concrete, and straddling two lanes invites side-swipe crashes.

sec08-card-sec08-F22.question_text: What does a solid white stripe mark at the road edge versus between same-direction lanes?
sec08-card-sec08-F22.teaching_text: Outer white stripes guide tires through rain and darkness, while solid white between lanes locks down weaving.

sec08-card-sec08-F24.question_text: What is the sole legal use of a center left-turn lane, and how are its yellow lines arranged?
sec08-card-sec08-F24.teaching_text: Cruising or overtaking down a center turn bay risks colliding head-on with opposing drivers pulling in.

sec08-card-sec08-F25.question_text: How are reversible lanes striped on both sides, and what normal yellow-line rule do they uniquely allow?
sec08-card-sec08-F25.teaching_text: Only open reversible lanes bordered by double broken yellow lines permit cruising to the left of yellow paint.

sec08-card-sec08-R05.question_text: How does a broken yellow line on your side compare with a solid yellow line on your side?
sec08-card-sec08-R05.teaching_text: Checking which stripe sits closest to your left tire determines whether overtaking is legal or a violation.
sec08-card-sec08-R05.must_match_memory_hook: Broken allows safe pass, solid bans

visual_sync.text_span: Broken allows safe pass, solid bans

sec08-card-sec08-R06.question_text: How do broken white lines and solid white lines between same-direction lanes differ?
sec08-card-sec08-R06.teaching_text: Dashed white lets you shift cleanly without straddling, whereas solid white demands holding your current lane.

sec08-card-sec08-R07.question_text: How do the yellow markings and legal uses separate a reversible lane from a center left-turn lane?
sec08-card-sec08-R07.teaching_text: Confusing double-dashed reversible through lanes with solid-outer center turn bays puts you into oncoming rush traffic.

sec08-card-sec08-F10.question_text: Why are intersection flashers hung at certain corners, and what two color setups can they display?
sec08-card-sec08-F10.teaching_text: Overhead flashers reinforce or replace stop signs by blinking red four ways or blinking yellow on the main road.

sec08-card-sec08-F11.question_text: What driver response is required at a circular flashing yellow versus a circular flashing red?
sec08-card-sec08-F11.teaching_text: Flashing yellow lets main-street traffic roll cautiously, while cross-street flashing red enforces a full stop sign.

sec08-card-sec08-F12.question_text: Under what two circumstances do regular signals switch to flashing mode, and what rules apply then?
sec08-card-sec08-F12.teaching_text: Late-night low volume or controller glitches trigger backup flasher mode where blinking red stops and blinking yellow cautions.

sec08-card-sec08-F13.question_text: What do a green downward arrow, a yellow X, and a red X directly over a lane each mean?
sec08-card-sec08-F13.teaching_text: Reading overhead lane gantries keeps you out of reversing rush-hour lanes before oncoming traffic arrives.
sec08-card-sec08-F13.must_match_memory_hook: Green open, yellow vacate, red closed

visual_sync.text_span: Green open, yellow vacate, red closed

sec08-card-sec08-F14.question_text: On what kind of streets are special overhead lane signals installed, and what do they show?
sec08-card-sec08-F14.teaching_text: Bridges, tunnels, and commuter avenues flip lane directions by time of day using overhead lane indicators.

sec08-card-sec08-R03.question_text: What is the core legal contrast between circular flashing yellow and circular flashing red?
sec08-card-sec08-R03.teaching_text: Rolling past flashing red without stopping violates right-of-way just like blowing through an octagonal stop sign.

sec08-card-sec08-R04.question_text: How does your required action under an overhead yellow X differ from an overhead red X?
sec08-card-sec08-R04.teaching_text: Yellow X gives transition time to merge out safely before red X closes the lane or sends opposing cars.
sec08-card-sec08-R04.must_match_memory_hook: Leave yellow soon, never enter red

visual_sync.text_span: Leave yellow soon, never enter red

sec08-card-sec08-F01.question_text: Which yellow shapes and white crossbuck design mark rail crossings, and when is a track-count plaque added?
sec08-card-sec08-F01.teaching_text: Checking for a number plaque beneath the white X crossbuck warns you when two or more tracks cross.

sec08-card-sec08-F02.question_text: What three electrical devices warn of approaching trains, who holds priority, and what penalty hits ignoring them?
sec08-card-sec08-F02.teaching_text: Trains always hold absolute right-of-way, and running flashing red rail lights or lowered barriers brings a citation.

sec08-card-sec08-F03.question_text: What two hazards must you guard against at multi-track crossings and behind slow traffic?
sec08-card-sec08-F03.teaching_text: Wait until the car ahead clears enough room beyond the rails so you never get pinned across active tracks.

sec08-card-sec08-R10.question_text: How do advance yellow rail signs, white crossbucks, and multi-track plaques fit together?
sec08-card-sec08-R10.teaching_text: Advance yellow panels alert you early while the white X crossbuck and track-count plaque sit right at the rails.

sec08-card-sec08-F15.question_text: What do the hand or DON'T WALK display and the walking figure or WALK display command pedestrians to do?
sec08-card-sec08-F15.teaching_text: Knowing pedestrian signal phases helps turning motorists anticipate when walkers legally step off the curb.

sec08-card-sec08-F16.question_text: What do intersection and school-zone crosswalks signal to approaching motorists?
sec08-card-sec08-F16.teaching_text: Heightened scanning at school and corner crosswalks catches distracted or small walkers before braking distance vanishes.

sec08-card-sec08-F17.question_text: Where on West Virginia roads does a blind pedestrian with a service animal or white cane hold right-of-way?
sec08-card-sec08-F17.teaching_text: Guide dogs, service animals, and white canes trigger unconditional driver yielding even midblock without painted stripes.

sec08-card-sec08-F23.question_text: Which three special travel modes are designated by white diamond shapes painted inside a lane?
sec08-card-sec08-F23.teaching_text: Spotting white pavement diamonds warns solo drivers out of restricted HOV, bike, or bus lanes.

sec08-card-sec08-F26.question_text: How do marked and residential unmarked crosswalks look, and what must your car never do on one?
sec08-card-sec08-F26.teaching_text: Parking your hood across a crosswalk forces walkers out into moving cross-street lanes around your bumper.

sec08-card-sec08-F27.question_text: What do wide white stop lines mark, and where do you stop when neither a stop line nor crosswalk exists?
sec08-card-sec08-F27.teaching_text: Wide stop bars protect walkers and cross traffic, while unmarked corners require halting before entry with full visibility.

sec08-card-sec08-R09.question_text: How do pedestrian walk signals contrast with the rule for a blind pedestrian using a cane or guide dog?
sec08-card-sec08-R09.teaching_text: Ordinary walkers follow WALK and hand icons inside crosswalks, whereas blind pedestrians hold priority anywhere on any road.

sec08-card-sec08-R11.question_text: How do wide white stop lines differ in function from solid white crosswalk lines?
sec08-card-sec08-R11.teaching_text: Your front tires stop behind the wide white bar so your chassis never sits inside the twin crosswalk lines.
sec08-card-sec08-R11.must_match_memory_hook: Stop bar halts, crosswalk stays clear

visual_sync.text_span: Stop bar halts, crosswalk stays clear

sec15-card-sec15-F16.question_text: Who makes sure passengers buckle up, and which two exceptions exist under West Virginia's safety belt law?
sec15-card-sec15-F16.teaching_text: Every front-seat rider and every minor anywhere in the vehicle must buckle unless carrying proof for a medical exemption.

sec15-card-sec15-F17.question_text: By what percentage does a safety belt cut injury or death risk, and where must the lap and shoulder belts rest?
sec15-card-sec15-F17.teaching_text: Spreading crash energy across pelvic bones and the chest lets your body slow with the cabin instead of striking the dash.
sec15-card-sec15-F17.must_match_memory_hook: Cuts risk near half, low hips

visual_sync.text_span: Cuts risk near half, low hips

sec15-card-sec15-F18.question_text: How does a properly worn safety belt help you both in crashes and on bumpy or winding roads?
sec15-card-sec15-F18.teaching_text: Staying planted squarely behind the wheel keeps your hands and feet in control across sharp curves or potholes.

sec15-card-sec15-F19.question_text: When must a child under eight use a federally approved safety device, and what height allows a regular belt?
sec15-card-sec15-F19.teaching_text: Adult belts ride dangerously across a small child's stomach and neck until height reaches four feet nine inches.

sec15-card-sec15-R03.question_text: Compare the age-and-seat exception for adult safety belts with the height exception for children under eight?
sec15-card-sec15-R03.teaching_text: DMV questions test both cutoffs together so you never confuse adult rear-seat rules with child booster height.

sec15-card-sec15-R04.question_text: How much does wearing a safety belt reduce crash injury or death risk, and how should the lap strap fit?
sec15-card-sec15-R04.teaching_text: Riding the lap strap low across strong hip bones prevents internal abdominal injuries during sudden deceleration.

sec15-card-sec15-R07.question_text: Where is a rear-facing infant seat strictly forbidden, and where do children twelve and under belong?
sec15-card-sec15-R07.teaching_text: An inflating front passenger bag strikes the back of a rear-facing carrier right behind an infant's head.

sec15-card-sec15-F20.question_text: What injury do head restraints help prevent, and where should an adjustable restraint sit?
sec15-card-sec15-F20.teaching_text: Setting a pad down behind your neck acts like a pivot point instead of catching your skull in a rear-end hit.

sec15-card-sec15-F21.question_text: How must you brake and steer during a quick stop with anti-lock brakes, and why must you never pump them?
sec15-card-sec15-F21.teaching_text: Letting off or pumping defeats rapid computer pulsing and can drain stopping force right when you need control.

sec15-card-sec15-F22.question_text: At best, how much do anti-lock brakes shorten a sudden stop compared with ordinary brakes?
sec15-card-sec15-F22.teaching_text: Treating anti-lock brakes like magic stopping power tempts tailgating when their real advantage is steering control.

sec15-card-sec15-F23.question_text: In what years did dual air bags become required on passenger cars and on new light trucks?
sec15-card-sec15-F23.teaching_text: Explosive deployment force saves thousands of front occupants yet demands proper seating habits to prevent bag injuries.

sec15-card-sec15-F24.question_text: With an air bag in the wheel, why must you buckle up, where do your hands go, and how should front seats sit?
sec15-card-sec15-F24.teaching_text: Holding the lower wheel rim keeps your forearms from being blasted into your face if the bag fires.
sec15-card-sec15-F24.must_match_memory_hook: Buckle up, grip four-and-eight, tilt back

visual_sync.text_span: Buckle up, grip four-and-eight, tilt back

sec15-card-sec15-F25.question_text: What rules govern rear-facing infants, unavoidable front-seat child riders, and children twelve and under around air bags?
sec15-card-sec15-F25.teaching_text: Only an unavoidable forward-facing child with the seat slid all the way back avoids lethal front bag impact.
sec15-card-sec15-F25.must_match_memory_hook: Never rear-facing front, slide seat back

visual_sync.text_span: Never rear-facing front, slide seat back

sec15-card-sec15-R05.question_text: Why does old-school brake pumping backfire in a vehicle equipped with anti-lock brakes?
sec15-card-sec15-R05.teaching_text: Manual pumping interrupts hydraulic pressure regulation and can cost you braking power mid-emergency.

sec15-card-sec15-R06.question_text: Since anti-lock brakes trim sudden stops by roughly ten percent at most, what is their true main benefit?
sec15-card-sec15-R06.teaching_text: Being able to steer around an obstacle while braking hard matters far more than a slight distance cut.
sec15-card-sec15-R06.must_match_memory_hook: Steering control beats small distance gain

visual_sync.text_span: Steering control beats small distance gain

sec15-card-sec15-R08.question_text: What clock positions hold the steering wheel safely around an air bag, and what did most air-bag fatalities lack?
sec15-card-sec15-R08.teaching_text: Unbelted riders slide forward right onto the steering hub at the exact millisecond the bag explodes outward.

sec15-card-sec15-R11.question_text: Against which part of your body must an adjustable head restraint rest to reduce whiplash?
sec15-card-sec15-R11.teaching_text: Supporting the solid back of the skull keeps your head and torso moving together when struck from behind.

sec15-card-sec15-F01.question_text: Who is responsible for safe vehicle condition, and which nine equipment defects commonly cause crashes?
sec15-card-sec15-F01.teaching_text: Worn wipers, faulty exhausts, dead bulbs, or broken mirrors turn routine weather and traffic into avoidable wrecks.
sec15-card-sec15-F01.must_match_memory_hook: Driver maintains tires, brakes, lights, belts

visual_sync.text_span: Driver maintains tires, brakes, lights, belts

sec15-card-sec15-F02.question_text: Which four common physical or mental driver conditions undermine safe vehicle operation?
sec15-card-sec15-F02.teaching_text: Even a mechanically spotless car turns hazardous when the person steering is drowsy, impaired, upset, or missing sights and sounds.

sec15-card-sec15-F03.question_text: How does fatigue hurt driving, and what should you do when tired alone versus with licensed passengers?
sec15-card-sec15-F03.teaching_text: Willpower cannot speed up dulled brain reflexes, so only real rest off-road or a fresh licensed driver fixes drowsiness.

sec15-card-sec15-F04.question_text: How often and for how long should you rest on a long trip, where should you spend that break, and what fights monotony?
sec15-card-sec15-F04.teaching_text: Stepping out into fresh air resets circulation far better than sitting parked, while fresh air or music breaks highway boredom.
sec15-card-sec15-F04.must_match_memory_hook: Ten minutes outside every two hours

visual_sync.text_span: Ten minutes outside every two hours

sec15-card-sec15-F05.question_text: What should you do if anger, worry, or fear hits before you get behind the wheel?
sec15-card-sec15-F05.teaching_text: Strong emotions hijack attention and tempt aggressive inputs when traffic demands steady judgment.

sec15-card-sec15-R01.question_text: What is the exact timing and location rule for rest breaks on a long road trip?
sec15-card-sec15-R01.teaching_text: Exam traps offer staying belted in the seat, yet the rule only counts when you stretch outside the vehicle.
sec15-card-sec15-R01.must_match_memory_hook: Every two hours, ten minutes outside

visual_sync.text_span: Every two hours, ten minutes outside

sec15-card-sec15-F09.question_text: Because the vehicle ahead can brake suddenly without warning, what three habits protect you from rear-ending it?
sec15-card-sec15-F09.teaching_text: Building a generous cushion ahead buys braking room even if the lead car's brake lights never give early notice.
sec15-card-sec15-F09.must_match_memory_hook: Stay alert, anticipate stops, keep space

visual_sync.text_span: Stay alert, anticipate stops, keep space

sec15-card-sec15-F10.question_text: What duty do you owe a tailgating driver behind you whenever you slow down, stop, or turn?
sec15-card-sec15-F10.teaching_text: Giving a tailgater early warning protects your own rear bumper when they left themselves almost zero reaction gap.

sec15-card-sec15-F11.question_text: What common errors or emergencies might send an oncoming vehicle across the centerline into your lane?
sec15-card-sec15-F11.teaching_text: Expecting wide curve cuts, obstacle dodges, or pavement-edge overcorrections keeps your eyes scanning an escape path right.

sec15-card-sec15-F12.question_text: Where do you encounter vehicles approaching at an angle, and what keeps those conflict points safe?
sec15-card-sec15-F12.teaching_text: Side-impact zones pack crossing paths tightly together, making strict right-of-way and signal compliance vital.

sec15-card-sec15-F13.question_text: How should you react when another driver starts passing you?
sec15-card-sec15-F13.teaching_text: Speeding up to block a passer traps them in the oncoming lane and triggers deadly head-on or sideswipe wrecks.
sec15-card-sec15-F13.must_match_memory_hook: Ease off, hug right, zero ego

visual_sync.text_span: Ease off, hug right, zero ego

sec15-card-sec15-F14.question_text: May you exceed the posted speed limit to pass, and what does needing extra speed tell you?
sec15-card-sec15-F14.teaching_text: If a lead car is already moving near the limit, forcing a pass adds crash risk and fuel burn for almost zero time saved.

sec15-card-sec15-F15.question_text: Walk through the key checks, warnings, and mirror cue in West Virginia's ten-step safe passing sequence?
sec15-card-sec15-F15.teaching_text: Waiting until the passed car's headlights appear in your inside mirror guarantees you will not clip its front bumper.
sec15-card-sec15-F15.must_match_memory_hook: Check, signal, warn, see both headlights

visual_sync.text_span: Check, signal, warn, see both headlights

sec15-card-sec15-R09.question_text: What is your job when being passed versus the speed-limit rule when you are the one passing?
sec15-card-sec15-R09.teaching_text: Cooperative passing keeps exposure time in the opposing lane brief without anyone breaking the posted ceiling.
sec15-card-sec15-R09.must_match_memory_hook: Slow right when passed, obey limit

visual_sync.text_span: Slow right when passed, obey limit

sec15-card-sec15-R10.question_text: In the ten passing steps, how do you alert the driver ahead and when is it safe to merge back right?
sec15-card-sec15-R10.teaching_text: Alerting the lead driver prevents a surprise left drift, and spotting headlights in your mirror confirms safe clearance.
sec15-card-sec15-R10.must_match_memory_hook: Tap horn or lights, mirror headlights

visual_sync.text_span: Tap horn or lights, mirror headlights

sec15-card-sec15-F06.question_text: What are the usual weekday morning inbound and afternoon outbound metro rush hours, and when do industrial areas peak?
sec15-card-sec15-F06.teaching_text: Anticipating commuter surges and factory shift changes helps you expect packed lanes and hurried lane-weavers.

sec15-card-sec15-F07.question_text: How does traffic risk shift from weekday commutes to weekends, summer vacations, and holiday weekends?
sec15-card-sec15-F07.teaching_text: Unfamiliar tourists logging long hours alongside impaired holiday drivers create erratic highway behavior.
sec15-card-sec15-F07.must_match_memory_hook: Longer trips bring tired, impaired drivers

visual_sync.text_span: Longer trips bring tired, impaired drivers

sec15-card-sec15-F08.question_text: Contrast typical rural driving hazards with urban ones, and what shared challenge do heavy trucks and buses add?
sec15-card-sec15-F08.teaching_text: Country roads mix fast cars with slow farm gear and wildlife, while cities pack crosswalks and intersections tightly.
sec15-card-sec15-F08.must_match_memory_hook: Tractors and deer versus city stops

visual_sync.text_span: Tractors and deer versus city stops

sec15-card-sec15-F26.question_text: What four personal safety habits apply to doors, windows, hitchhikers, and phones before and during a drive?
sec15-card-sec15-F26.teaching_text: Locked cabins and pre-set hands-free devices protect both personal security at stops and visual focus on the move.
sec15-card-sec15-F26.must_match_memory_hook: Lock doors, skip hitchhikers, hands-free phone

visual_sync.text_span: Lock doors, skip hitchhikers, hands-free phone

sec15-card-sec15-F27.question_text: Where should you lock valuables, and where should you go instead of stopping on the roadside if lost?
sec15-card-sec15-F27.teaching_text: Visible bags invite smash-and-grabs, and dark shoulders expose lost drivers when bright gas stations or diners are safer.
sec15-card-sec15-F27.must_match_memory_hook: Hide valuables, check maps somewhere busy

visual_sync.text_span: Hide valuables, check maps somewhere busy

sec15-card-sec15-F28.question_text: What safety checks belong when walking up to your parked car, and what should you do if someone follows you?
sec15-card-sec15-F28.teaching_text: Approaching alert under bright lights prevents parking-lot ambushes, and heading to a busy spot beats leading a follower home.
sec15-card-sec15-F28.must_match_memory_hook: Keys ready, check car, dial nine-one-one

visual_sync.text_span: Keys ready, check car, dial nine-one-one

sec15-card-sec15-R02.question_text: Which two-hour windows mark metro inbound morning rush hour and outbound afternoon rush hour?
sec15-card-sec15-R02.teaching_text: Keeping those two exact two-hour windows straight nails West Virginia's traffic-volume test questions.
